HowItWorks.tt: ArcaneGPT: Automating Crypto Quant Factor Mining with AI | AMCC
HowItWorks.td: Discover how AMCC leverages ArcaneGPT and Low-Rank Decay (LoRD) regularization to overcome overfitting and automatically generate high-performance crypto trading strategies.
HowItWorks.jsonLdH: ArcaneGPT: The Next-Generation AI Quant Factor Mining Engine
HowItWorks.jsonLdD: AMCC reveals the next generation of automated crypto trading strategy generation technology.
HowItWorks.h1: An AI That Automatically ‘Invents’ Trading Formulas
HowItWorks.h2: Breaking the overfitting barrier: AMCC unveils next-generation automated Meme coin trading strategy generation.
HowItWorks.h4: Imagine hiring a genius intern specialized in quantitative indicators. Every day, they write thousands of mathematical formulas. You test which ones are profitable and guide future optimization based on the results.
HowItWorks.h6: Responsible for creative exploration. Instead of text, it outputs instruction tokens that combine into complex indicators humans would never think of.
HowItWorks.h8: Responsible for execution. It applies generated formulas to real-time crypto market data to compute actionable trading signals.
HowItWorks.h10: Responsible for evaluation. Profitable formulas are crowned as the “New King”, while erroneous or losing ones are eliminated.
HowItWorks.h12: Why Do AI-Generated Strategies Often Fail?
HowItWorks.h13: The most common issue is overfitting — AI tends to memorize noise in historical data. Strategies look perfect in backtests but fail in live trading.
HowItWorks.h14: “LoRD is like putting the AI’s brain on a diet. By enforcing low-rank matrices, it prevents overthinking and improves generalization.”

HowItWorks.h18: You don’t need to write a single line of trading logic. Simply provide the data (candlesticks, on-chain metrics), and ArcaneGPT will tirelessly explore combinations and deliver the most profitable formulas directly to you.
